  Item 8.01.      Other Events.  

On February 5, 2026, JPMorgan Chase & Co. closed a public offering of $3,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Fixed-to-FloatingRate Subordinated Notes due 2037 (the “ Subordinated Notes”).

The offering of the Subordinated Notes was registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, pursuant to a registration statement on FormS-3(FileNo. 333-285537), as amended. In connection with this offering, the legal opinion as to the legality of the Subordinated Notes is being filed as Exhibit 5.1 to this report.
